sample_size_basis: Fixed resource scope of at most 100 different usable accounts, not a prospective statistical power calculation.

selection_rule.exclusions: All user IDs explicitly present in all 50 official public user_scenario fields, plus all get_user_details user_id arguments in saved prior research_pilots/ecrc_*/.../runs/.../{TOOL_CALLS,MESSAGES}.json transcripts, excluding vendor paths and the current coverage project.
selection_rule.structural_eligibility: User record key equals user_id and at least one user-list reservation exists with matching reservation_id and ownership user_id. Keep every structurally valid association; discard only invalid associations. Do not inspect business eligibility or outcomes.
selection_rule.tie_break: Ascending hash, then ascending identifier string.
selection_rule.sampling: First min(100, available) accounts by account hash; one structurally owned reservation per account by reservation hash. No replacement or positive-case oversampling.
selection_rule.request_generation: Generate each health, other, and unspecified template once for the same selected reservation. Retain every template and all outcomes.

templates.statement: Cancel reservation {reservation_id} because I am sick.
Cancel reservation {reservation_id}. I booked it by mistake.

interpretation: Native DB records plus author-written request templates: a controlled coverage experiment, not new official benchmark tasks, independent holdout, or real user requests.
One native reservation per selected account; three reason variants share the account and reservation and are paired conditions, not 300 independent account samples.
No model, eligibility function, gold actions, evaluator fields, or business outcomes are used in cohort selection.
The account exclusion audit records known prior public/task/runtime exposure, not a guarantee that records have never been seen by any author.
Every candidate is retained. Missing, expired, invalid, already-completed, unsupported, and adverse cases must remain in reporting after execution.
